name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: Code to read and copy: the dashboard's light card with numbered, wrapped lines, or the site's dark code window.
usage: Use for a request, a response or a snippet someone will read or copy. In the product use the default look (a JSON response, a webhook payload, an SDK call); on the site use variant terminal. Give it a CodeBlockHeader with CodeBlockTitle (the file or language) and a CodeBlockCopyButton, then CodeBlockContent with the code and its language. For an interactive JSON response with folding and search use JsonViewer; for a sample in several languages on the site use CodeTabs.
avoid: A dark block in the product
Syntax colors outside the code tokens

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
